en: The Pair on Leading-forth (Niyyānikaduka) and the Triplet on the Wholesome (Kusalattika).
Dependent on a leading, wholesome state, a non-leading, unwholesome state arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a non-leading, wholesome state, a non-leading, unwholesome state arises by way of root condition. Under root condition there are two; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are two.

Dependent on a state that is non-emancipating and unwholesome, there arises a state that is neither emancipating nor unwholesome by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). There is one [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance. (The indeterminate root has two conditions.)
